art: Minimal Japanese product and craft photography for an art-supply boutique: warm off-white washi-paper backgrounds with visible paper fibres, soft natural window light from the left, gentle long shadows, wabi-sabi calm, one small vermilion-red accent allowed, photorealistic, shallow depth of field. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no packaging labels.

jobs.prompt: Flat-lay still life on handmade washi paper: calligraphy brushes resting on a ceramic brush rest, a sumi ink stick and a stone inkwell, a small tin of watercolour half-pans, and a sheet of paper bearing a single bold ink enso circle, generous empty space on the left.
A slim metal tin of twelve Japanese artist watercolour half-pans, open, showing rich colours, with a small round brush lying beside it, on washi paper background.
A traditional sumi ink stick with a gold-embossed relief pattern leaning on a round stone inkstone (suzuri) holding a pool of fresh black ink, on washi paper background.
Three Japanese calligraphy brushes (fude) with bamboo handles and tapered animal-hair tips lying on a ceramic brush rest, on washi paper background.
A stack of handmade washi paper sheets with visible plant fibres, tied with a thin vermilion cord, a corner of the top sheet slightly lifted, on a pale wooden surface.
Small glass jars of nihonga mineral pigments in vivid malachite green, azurite blue, cinnabar red and ochre, arranged in a shallow wooden tray, on washi paper background.
A booklet of gold leaf (kinpaku) with one thin gold sheet lifted on a pair of bamboo tweezers, glowing softly, on washi paper background.
A set of premium graphite drawing pencils in graded shades lying in a slim open wooden box with a small brass sharpener, sharpened tips, on washi paper background.
A linen-bound sketchbook lying open on a page of delicate pencil studies of a pine branch, with a vermilion bookmark ribbon and a pencil, on pale wood.
The hands of an artisan (no face) binding the hair tuft of a calligraphy brush in a quiet traditional workshop, thread, bamboo handles and small tools on a worn wooden bench, warm window light.
Traditional washi papermaking: a craftsperson's hands (no face) lifting a bamboo screen holding a wet sheet of paper pulp from a wooden vat, soft steam, a quiet workshop with warm window light.

The calm interior of a Japanese art-supply boutique: pale wooden shelves of paper, brushes and ink, paper lanterns, a low table with a few brushes laid out, soft daylight through a shoji screen. No people, no readable signage.

logo.concept: a brush-painted enso circle that is not quite closed, with a small stylised cloud shape tucked inside its lower half, sumi-e ink brush stroke style, high contrast

icons.style: Japanese sumi-e ink-brush icons painted with a few confident calligraphic strokes, varied stroke width, minimal
